facts: At the start of spring, Mira kept the brass compass in the cedar chest.

facts: After the flood, Mira settled in the hill cottage, where she still lives.

facts: Theo now works as the harbor librarian and has done so since the winter festival.

facts: Mira placed the silver lantern in the pantry, and it is still there.

facts: Mira keeps the astronomy journal in the desk drawer.
